arch.description: CPU architecture for the chroot (e.g., x86_64, aarch64). Defaults to host architecture if not set.

alpine_branch.description: Alpine branch to install (e.g., v3.19, edge).

chroot_dir.description: Absolute path to the chroot directory (required).

bind_dir.description: Absolute path on host to bind-mount inside chroot. Defaults to PWD if under /home, otherwise none.

chroot_keep_vars.description: Environment variable names (ERE patterns) to pass from host to chroot.

alpine_mirror.description: URI of Alpine Aports mirror. Empty uses default http://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine.

alpine_packages.description: List of Alpine packages to install into chroot. Defaults to build-base ca-certificates ssl_client if empty.

extra_repos.description: List of additional Alpine repositories to add to /etc/apk/repositories.

temp_dir.description: Absolute path to temporary directory for bootstrap files. Empty uses mktemp -d.

apk_tools_uri.description: Full URL of apk.static binary to download.

apk_tools_sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the apk.static binary, used for integrity verification.
